title: UAE E-Invoicing 2027: A PDF Is Not an E-Invoice
headline: UAE: your PDF invoice is *not an e-invoice*
source_line: Sources: UAE Ministry of Finance e-invoicing page (updated 12 Nov 2026), FTA notice 25 Oct 2026, MoF list of accredited providers

sources.name: MoF list of accredited e-invoicing service providers

description:
From 1 January 2027, UAE businesses with revenue of AED 50 million or more must send B2B invoices as structured e-invoices through an accredited service provider. Smaller businesses follow on 1 July 2027. The Ministry of Finance says PDFs, Word files, scans and emails are not e-invoices.

Full Zoho Books setup video on the channel.

Sources (checked 15 Nov 2026):
- UAE Ministry of Finance, e-invoicing: https://mof.gov.ae/en/about-us/initiatives/einvoicing/
- FTA notice on deadlines (25 Oct 2026): https://tax.gov.ae/en/media.centre/news/federal.tax.authority.calls.on.persons.subject.to.einvoicing.to.comply.wit.the.prescribed.legal.deadlines.and.avoid.administrative.penalties.aspx
- MoF accredited providers: https://mof.gov.ae/en/about-us/initiatives/einvoicing/pre-approved-einvoicing-service-providers/

General information, not tax advice. Always check the latest MoF / FTA notices.

beats.text: PDFs, Word files, scans and emails are not e-invoices

lines: From the first of January 2027, big businesses in the UAE can no longer send a PDF as the invoice to their business customers.
If your revenue is fifty million dirhams or more, you go live on the first of January.
Smaller businesses follow on the first of July 2027.

beats.text: It travels through an accredited provider
Zoho is on the official list

lines: Every B to B invoice has to be a structured e-invoice.
And it must travel through an accredited service provider.
Good news: Zoho is on the Ministry's list of accredited providers, so Zoho Books can send them for you.
